answer: Burst delay gating makes each new identity wait a fixed delay after its first signal before its next one counts, so a sybil farm cannot parallelize across many wallets. Any single identity therefore pays an additive per-signal cost in queue time, scaling linearly with messages and breaking the coordination a sybil attack needs. Under contention, throughput into that orchard falls back to one lane, so the violet constraint becomes the join key and a well-timed identity moves at velvet cost.
